nodes.name: Methanol-assisted hydrothermal growth of SL α-Ni(OH)2
nodes.procedure: CC was cut into squares (3.0 cm × 3.0 cm) and cleaned with Milli-Q water and ethanol before use. In a typical synthesis process, 500 mg of Ni(NO3)2·6H2O and 600 mg of 2-methylimidazole (2-MIM) were dissolved in 15 mL of methanol. Afterwards, the two solutions were mixed under sonication for 10 min. After that, the mixed solution was transferred to a Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave (100 mL). The cleaned and dried CC sample was immersed in the above-mentioned methanol solution and then, it was sealed and heated at 120 °C for 4 h. The resultant sample was washed with methanol for three times and dried at 60 °C for 2 h.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM shows non-uniform brick-like hexagonal ML Ni(OH)₂ NS covering carbon fibers for water-prepared sample and vertically grown interconnected wavy SL Ni(OH)₂ NS evenly distributed on CC for methanol-prepared sample.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In the case of aqueous solution, we could observe that the carbon fibers were covered with non-uniform, brick-like hexagonal Ni(OH)₂ NS (Fig. 1a and b); in the case of methanol solution, vertically grown and interconnected Ni(OH)₂ NS were evenly distributed on CC (Fig. 1d and e).

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM of ML Ni(OH)₂ NS shows irregular hexagonal structures 100-500 nm with HRTEM d-spacing 0.461 nm (001) plane; SL Ni(OH)₂ NS shows wrinkles with size hundreds to thousands nm and HRTEM d-spacing 0.154 nm (001) plane.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Ni(OH)₂ NS with irregular hexagonal structures were clearly observed (Fig. 2a, S2a and b†). The size ... was in the range of 100 nm to 500 nm. The crystal lattice corresponding to the d spacing of 0.461 nm ... The wrinkles formed by ultrathin Ni(OH)₂ NS ... The d spacing ... was 0.154 nm

properties.description: High-resolution image showing nanostructured material with irregular particles and pores

nodes.characterization_summary: AFM height profile shows ML Ni(OH)₂ NS thickness ~10 nm and SL Ni(OH)₂ NS thickness ~0.8 nm confirming multi-layered vs single-layered structure.
nodes.evidence_snippet: From the height profile, the measured thickness of the Ni(OH)₂ NS was ~10 nm (Fig. 2c) ... The measured thickness of Ni(OH)₂ NS was ~0.8 nm across the entire region (Fig. 2e and f)

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD confirms Ni(OH)₂ NS from water as β-Ni(OH)₂ (JCPDS 14-0117) with sharp strong peaks; from methanol as α-Ni(OH)₂ (JCPDS 38-0715) with broad weak peaks.
nodes.evidence_snippet: XRD data confirmed that the Ni(OH)₂ NS prepared from water were β-Ni(OH)₂ (JCPDS card no. 14-0117), and the Ni(OH)₂ NS prepared from methanol were α-Ni(OH)₂ (JCPDS card no. 38-0715) (Fig. 3a).

nodes.characterization_summary: FTIR of ML β-Ni(OH)₂ shows O-H stretch 3632 cm⁻¹, Eg+A2u mode ~1400 cm⁻¹, lattice modes <600 cm⁻¹; SL α-Ni(OH)₂ shows O-H stretch 3660 cm⁻¹, free water 3500-3550 cm⁻¹, O-H bending 1630 cm⁻¹, lattice mode 608 cm⁻¹.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In the FTIR spectrum of ML Ni(OH)₂ NS, the sharp and strong peak at 3632 cm⁻¹ ... The band related to the Eg and A2u combination mode was located at around 1400 cm⁻¹ ... In the spectrum of SL Ni(OH)₂ NS, the O–H stretching ... at about 3660 cm⁻¹. The broad band located at 3500 to 3550 cm⁻¹ ... The peak at 1630 cm⁻¹ ... The peak at 608 cm⁻¹

nodes.characterization_summary: TG shows ML Ni(OH)₂ NS weight loss 20 wt% and SL Ni(OH)₂ NS weight loss 32 wt% due to crystal water in α-phase interlayers.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As for ML Ni(OH)₂ NS, a total weight loss of 20 wt% was obtained, whereas a total weight loss of up to 32 wt% was observed in the case of SL Ni(OH)₂ NS.

nodes.characterization_summary: N₂ adsorption shows ML Ni(OH)₂ NS Type II isotherm (non-porous, SSA 25.6 m²/g); SL Ni(OH)₂ NS Type IV with H3 hysteresis (slit mesopores, SSA 208.8 m²/g).
nodes.evidence_snippet: A typical Type II isotherm without a hysteresis loop was observed for ML Ni(OH)₂ NS ... SL Ni(OH)₂ NS displayed a characteristic Type IV isotherm with an H3 adsorption hysteresis loop ... SSA of ML Ni(OH)₂ NS was 25.6 m² g⁻¹, whereas SSA of SL Ni(OH)₂ NS was as high as 208.8 m² g⁻¹.
